messages.content: You are a helpful assistant that translates Java code to GNU C++11 code. The code should reads and writes I/O from the console.

samples.content:
<translated_code>
#include <iostream>
#include <vector>
#include <queue>
#include <map>
#include <string>
#include <algorithm>
#include <climits>
#include <sstream>
#include <random>
#include <fstream>
#include <cctype>

using namespace std;

class DStress2 {
public:
    void solve() {
        int n = in.nextInt();
        string s = in.nextToken();
        vector<char> svec(s.begin(), s.end());
        cout << solve(svec) << endl;
    }

    void stress() {
        mt19937 rng(123);
        for (int IT = 0; IT < 10000; IT++) {
            uniform_int_distribution<int> dist_n(1, 12);
            int n = dist_n(rng);
            string c(n, ' ');
            uniform_int_distribution<int> dist_char(0, 2);
            string chars = "AVK";
            for (int i = 0; i < n; i++) {
                c[i] = chars[dist_char(rng)];
            }

            int ans1 = solve(c);
            int ans2 = stupid(c);
            if (ans1 != ans2) {
                cerr << IT << " " << ans1 << " " << ans2 << " " << c << endl;
                break;
            }
        }
    }

    int INF = INT_MAX / 3;

    int stupid(string s) {
        queue<string> q;
        map<string, int> dist;
        q.push(s);
        dist[s] = 0;
        while (!q.empty()) {
            s = q.front();
            q.pop();
            int cur = dist[s];
            if (s.find("VK") == string::npos) {
                return cur;
            }

            for (int pos = 0; pos < (int)s.length() - 1; pos++) {
                string next = s.substr(0, pos) + s[pos + 1] + s[pos] + s.substr(pos + 2);
                if (dist.find(next) == dist.end()) {
                    dist[next] = cur + 1;
                    q.push(next);
                }
            }
        }
        return 0;
    }

    int solve(vector<char> s) {
        vector<int> vPos, kPos, otherPos;

        for (int i = 0; i < (int)s.size(); i++) {
            if (s[i] == 'V') {
                vPos.push_back(i);
            } else if (s[i] == 'K') {
                kPos.push_back(i);
            } else {
                otherPos.push_back(i);
            }
        }
        
        int vSize = vPos.size();
        int kSize = kPos.size();
        int oSize = otherPos.size();
        
        vector<vector<vector<vector<int>>>> dp(2, 
            vector<vector<vector<int>>>(vSize + 1, 
                vector<vector<int>>(kSize + 1, 
                    vector<int>(oSize + 1, INF))));
        
        dp[0][0][0][0] = 0;
        
        for (int V = 0; V <= vSize; V++) {
            for (int K = 0; K <= kSize; K++) {
                for (int O = 0; O <= oSize; O++) {
                    for (int last = 0; last < 2; last++) {
                        int cur = dp[last][V][K][O];
                        if (cur == INF) continue;
                        
                        if (V < vSize) {
                            int cost = count(vPos[V], K, kPos) + count(vPos[V], O, otherPos);
                            dp[1][V + 1][K][O] = min(dp[1][V + 1][K][O], cur + cost);
                        }
                        if (K < kSize && last == 0) {
                            int cost = count(kPos[K], V, vPos) + count(kPos[K], O, otherPos);
                            dp[0][V][K + 1][O] = min(dp[0][V][K + 1][O], cur + cost);
                        }
                        if (O < oSize) {
                            int cost = count(otherPos[O], V, vPos) + count(otherPos[O], K, kPos);
                            dp[0][V][K][O + 1] = min(dp[0][V][K][O + 1], cur + cost);
                        }
                    }
                }
            }
        }
        
        return min(dp[0][vSize][kSize][oSize], dp[1][vSize][kSize][oSize]);
    }

    int count(int val, int start, const vector<int>& vec) {
        int ans = 0;
        for (int i = start; i < (int)vec.size(); i++) {
            if (vec[i] < val) {
                ans++;
            }
        }
        return ans;
    }

    class FastScanner {
    public:
        BufferedReader br;
        string line;
        int pos;
        
        FastScanner() : br(stdin), pos(0) {}
        
        FastScanner(const string& s) : pos(0) {
            br = fopen(s.c_str(), "r");
        }
        
        string nextToken() {
            while (true) {
                if (pos >= (int)line.size()) {
                    if (!getline(br, line)) {
                        return "";
                    }
                    pos = 0;
                }
                while (pos < (int)line.size() && isspace(line[pos])) {
                    pos++;
                }
                if (pos >= (int)line.size()) continue;
                
                int start = pos;
                while (pos < (int)line.size() && !isspace(line[pos])) {
                    pos++;
                }
                return line.substr(start, pos - start);
            }
        }
        
        int nextInt() {
            return stoi(nextToken());
        }
        
        long nextLong() {
            return stol(nextToken());
        }
        
        double nextDouble() {
            return stod(nextToken());
        }
    };

    void run() {
        in = FastScanner();
        solve();
    }

private:
    FastScanner in;
};

int main() {
    DStress2 solver;
    solver.run();
    return 0;
}
